evidence.proves: revisions=2的Budget.revise明确quality_blocked，无归零；stalled保护也写入CP。

evidence.test_name: only explicit changed inputs produce g+1; operator preserves source allowance and source changes reset it with registered evidence
evidence.proves: 普通stage_completed不能重置耗尽计数，明确输入变更才g+1。

evidence.test_name: C084 real driver persists three blocking factual reviews and exactly two revisions; scheduled cold runs never query, upload or publish again
evidence.proves: 实际driver/executor/controller/FileStore三次定位事实错误blocking review、两次修订后quality_blocked/manual；跨两北京日期cold，草稿/context/counters/responses/invocations保留；模型/上传/PR零新增。

remaining.requirement: 真实模型重复事实错误的可定位审校回执与修订上限。
用户确认错误被准确识别且不合格笔记没有交付。

evidence.test_name: wired local preview uses real durable manager, controlled source/classifier and no remote publication on next run
evidence.proves: 单URL被受控分类回放正确excluded后report=success_no_selection、delivery keys为空；下一实例不重复模型。

evidence.test_name: the existing two configured source IDs can parse RSS atomically with stable bookmarks; genuine empty feeds remain healthy
evidence.proves: 明确空RSS被识别为success而非解析故障，不伪造候选。

evidence.test_name: scheduled two-source completion with %s candidates per source records zero selection and never creates an empty PR
evidence.proves: actual两个SourceAdapter/controller/HostManager/FileStore分别有效空RSS与所有候选价值判断skip回放。各来源success、零新model/PR、success_no_selection RunReport真实持久且cold恢复/next scheduled一致；当前无可执行合格积压，非preview测试。价值判断为明确替身，不证明真实空日来源/模型。

remaining.requirement: 两真实来源无新增/无合格内容时区分健康为空与读取失败。
正式受控零产出轮次报告和零PR实际观察。

evidence.test_name: publish-only does not hide a missed scheduled run
evidence.proves: 无scheduled事实时即便publish-only成功仍missed_schedule，不依赖阅读任务自报。

evidence.test_name: runner consumes trusted custom gap and deduplicates the same persistent incident on the next poll
evidence.proves: 独立runWatchdog读取Actions替身，门槛时点写入missed_schedule事件，同一下一poll Issue仍1、notices为空。

evidence.test_name: watchdog independently holds only readonly reports and implementation Issue capability
evidence.proves: 真实watchdog workflow独立cron 47 2,14、actions read/issues write，无阅读模型/正式写密钥。

remaining.requirement: 真实Actions阅读未触发但watchdog成功轮询，超过默认36h仅一个Issue/通知；读取历史attempt与报告缺失要实际验证。
生产启用后独立监控首次漏跑演练；目前正式cron仍未启用。

evidence.test_name: offline occurred+recovered events remain recorded even when final outcome healthy
evidence.proves: occurred/recovered历史同一Issue保留且closed。

evidence.test_name: watchdog API/read failure is visible as a deduplicated monitoring incident and never healthy
evidence.proves: policy read故障连续两poll仅一个open incident；恢复后closed、notice1。这是API仍可用的假Issue服务，不是GitHub整体不可用。

evidence.test_name: Actions and Issue API outage cannot report healthy or deliver a notification; recovery resumes persistent alerts without repeated notices
evidence.proves: 实际runWatchdog在真实持久故障/HEAD readonly投影上同时收到Actions API和Issue API不可用。函数失败不能报健康，通知/Issue写入0、workspace revision不变；恢复API后持久来源故障可投影open，重复poll不重发。模拟API故障不证明平台实际整体停调度，仍保留production_smoke边界。

remaining.requirement: 真实来源/运行故障恢复关闭对应Issue且不重发通知。
明确记录同平台全部停摆无法通知的运行手册及外部人工观察边界，不宣称同平台watchdog能自保。
